data.summary: Closing out after Brandon's escalation answer. PR #13 merged to main 2026-08-01T04:38Z (squash commit 54131e5): root cause (npm's silent auto-provenance failure under trusted publishing) documented in the PR body, fix is the explicit `--provenance` flag plus comment correction in release.yml. Workflow change was eyes-on reviewed via the escalation per the workflow-file law. Registry verification is deferred by nature: no v* tag has been pushed since the merge (latest is v0.1.1, pre-fix), so all five packages still show no dist.attestations — expected. Whoever pushes the next tag (v0.1.2+) should verify `npm view <pkg> --json` shows dist.attestations on all five packages and the npmjs provenance badge appears; if not, this comes back as a new task.
